name: MaintNet engines
author: Claude (assistant proposal)
source: MaintNet aviation maintenance logbook (Kaggle), imported as work orders; WO numbers are the dataset's IDENT values
note: Proposed labels for human review. Each question is phrased away from record titles; the expected records are the ones a correct answer must use. Questions with no_answer are checked against the full dataset text. v3 (v2 was a discarded copy) rewords two v1 questions that pointed at more than one fault; labels unchanged.

questions.question: What fixed the engine that died when someone tried to adjust the idle?
questions.why: 100002 replaced the fuel servo (the fix); 100001 shows the idle would not adjust. 100003 is a post-fix run-up, cut off at source.

questions.question: Which parts were cleaned to cure an engine vibration that had to be checked in the air?
questions.why: Fuel injector nozzles cleaned (#1, 3 and #2, 4) and plugs/leads work. 100908 only says 'for test flight'.

questions.question: What inspections followed an engine overspeed of about 3400 RPM during an autorotation?
questions.why: Valve-train and engine overspeed inspection steps. 100149 is only a leak check.

questions.question: What was found inside the engine after a 350 RPM magneto drop on the left side?
questions.why: 101580 found the oil control ring gap facing down; 101579 and 101582 are the cylinder findings and rework. 101581 is reassembly only.

questions.question: What was wrong with the cylinder whose compression read 25 psi with air escaping at the exhaust?
questions.why: Bent exhaust valve found. 103905 is only an ops and leak check.

questions.question: What was done about an oil line rubbing against the wiring?
questions.why: Oil return line replaced. 100275 is only a leak check.

questions.question: Which pump was replaced when an engine ran rough from the moment it was started?
questions.why: Engine-driven fuel pump replaced (104110); 104109 confirms the rough running from start. v3: v1's wording ('uneven running and a low idle') equally fitted MN-105847 (rough, idle low, valve work), so it no longer pointed at one fault.

questions.question: What work did cracks in the turbine nozzle require?
questions.why: Engine removal and disassembly, turbine swap with a loaner, reconnection and reinstallation.

questions.question: When oil was seen seeping out of the top cowl, what was the source?
questions.why: Leak verified at the lifting eye (105054) and three backbone bolts leaking (103863). v3: v1 said 'upper engine cover', which also reads as a rocker cover and matched MN-103078 (rocker cover gasket).

questions.question: How is a cylinder fixed when one of its valves keeps hanging up?
questions.why: Sticking-valve repairs across four incidents: staking, cylinder replacement or rework, exhaust guide reamed.

questions.question: What was done after the aircraft was struck by lightning?
questions.why: No record in the dataset mentions lightning.

questions.question: How was the cabin pressurisation fault fixed?
questions.why: No record mentions pressurisation. (A bird-strike question was dropped: the data has a prop-strike incident, which would make the label arguable.)

questions.question: How was the turbocharger wastegate fault fixed?
questions.why: No record mentions a turbocharger or wastegate.
